task: SC09-SB01 minimal changes for simplified procurement
actual_user_instruction: Dobierz zamienniki z TME, rozwiąż kwestię dławika i popraw SC09 tylko tam, gdzie trzeba. Policz koszt kompletu z dostawą. Ten sam branch, main unchanged, no repeated approvals; save current as przed uproszczonym zakupem.
requirements: Minimize PCB changes and retain opposite-edge AC/LED ports
No per-supplier freight for a single cheap part where technically avoidable
Prototype quantities and shipping priced explicitly
Original native sources preserved before edits
procurement_strategy: Prefer TME for selected stock items; retain one consolidated DigiKey basket for qualified originals and a manufacturer-supported HV energy choke. Prefer two reliable baskets over forcing an unqualified all-TME redesign.
selected_changes_proposed: C1 higher-voltage/pulse-rated47nFfilm, larger footprint only as needed
RV1 TDKSIOV-S07K275275VAC MOV with verified standard-lead geometry
R6 Royalohm3.65ohm1206 with updated TCR screen
unchanged_intent: Physical pin/net membership retained for all components, independently copied from prior reviewed functional intent and exact two-terminal datasheets, not inferred from changed CAD.
authorization: Current instruction explicitly authorizes design implementation and limited procurement-driven changes without repeated consent. It is not a fabricated approval of exact resulting schematic, production release, order or energized test.
review_plan: Freeze final source and calculation/procurement inputs, request four distinct read-only role inspections. Report gaps and actual failures; no approval fabricated.
acceptance_checks: Native DRC with schematic parity after refill
Exact graph membership vs independent retained intent
CAD clearance, body/keepout and trace inspection
Exact purchase quantities and two-delivery assumptions
